description: Verify an EdgeScreen Ed25519 signed audit receipt or PAYMENT-REFERRAL-RECEIPT for $0.00, without a wallet. Returns valid, receiptType, signerPublicKey, payloadSummary and verifiedAt using trusted server public keys. Unknown keys or tampering return valid=false; no payment or payout confirmation.

signedReceipt.description: Base64url signedReceipt from an audit or PAYMENT-REFERRAL-RECEIPT header.
